title: Group-A commissioned; the Chain Decoder; every stop explained
set_out: Make the web page the researcher package, record where every input lives outside our cloud account, commission Group-A on GitHub's machines while AWS is unavailable, and take the chain apart line by line for the Operations Manual.
open_at_turnover: Open: the Stage 0 bisulfite limit set from healthy arrays of several laboratories (to-do step 23); every blood cell scored in whole blood (step 21); the documentation pass (step 22); the Zenodo records for the book and the package and the AWS-side steps wait for the account.
closing: Group-A is commissioned and reproduced, every function of the chain is explained in the Operations Manual, and every stop the chain makes now says what it measured and why.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Group-A, synthetic first
entries.what: Groups drawn from 58 real tared healthy whole-blood readings: healthy against healthy is flagged in about 5 % of draws, and a planted loss of 0.70 % is found in at least 80 % of draws with 35 people per group.
entries.why: The group instrument has to stay quiet on healthy groups and see a small shift before any real data is opened.

entries.title: Group-A commissioned on whole blood (GRP-004)
entries.what: 278 healthy controls from a laboratory we had never read (GSE318173), chosen by metadata, read once on GitHub after a smoke test and a dress rehearsal on spent sets. 263 read; women and men read the same after the tare (-0.36 %, 1.2 standard errors); a planted 1 % loss of the neutrophils' pattern was found (+2.00 %, 7.3 standard errors). All three sealed bars met. A second reading from a later commit gave every number identical.
entries.why: One person's whole-blood reading is too noisy to call a small change; a group's average is not.

entries.title: Reproductions and the release check on GitHub (OTH-076, OTH-078)
entries.what: The Deconvolver's 200 mixtures rebuilt on GitHub with every number identical, after a folder path left by the move was fixed and a push check added for that kind of path. The mouse prediction rebuilt from public reads passed. Group-A became the tenth reproduction. The release check passed 32 of 32 from a fresh checkout.
entries.why: Every headline result has to rebuild from public data with one command, without our cloud account.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: The chain's whole-blood spread is 2.01 %, not 6.36 %
entries.what: An earlier development script skipped the chain's self-tare step; read by the chain itself, healthy whole bloods differ by 2.01 %, so one person needs about a 1.57 % loss to clear the healthy range. Per-person reading in whole blood is open again.
entries.why: The earlier figure had closed a question the chain itself had not answered.

entries.title: Two Stage 0 checks were misreading healthy arrays (GRP-004, PROC-STAGE0-04)
entries.what: The bisulfite check read all five control pairs in the green channel; three are red probes. Read in their own channels, healthy arrays read 0.927 to 0.978 in one laboratory instead of about 0.74. On two whole slides of another laboratory the high and low hybridization controls trade places exactly while the middle one stays put: a label swap, not a failed hybridization. Both are fixed in the chain, and no healthy rehearsal array is now stopped.
entries.why: When every healthy sample fails a check, the measurement is the first suspect.

entries.title: The front page is the researcher package
entries.what: The page opens with the introduction, the nine results rebuilt from public data with their commands, the clone of the biology folder and the Zenodo records, under the header The Physics of Methylation.
entries.why: A researcher should be able to start from the web address alone.

entries.title: IAM-A's healthy mark stated as it is
entries.what: The introduction, the Q&A, the page and the book's gauge, bridge and IAM-A chapters now say the floor and ceiling are derived and IAM-A's healthy mark is computed from the sample itself.
entries.why: IAM-A needs no control group, and the documents now say so.

entries.title: Where every input lives
entries.what: DATA_HOMES.md lists every chain input, every reproduction input with its public archive, and what the cloud bucket holds; the push is refused if any chain or test code reads the bucket.
entries.why: Nothing a researcher needs may depend on one cloud account.

entries.title: The cloud canon check passes again
entries.what: The old-value guards had matched digits inside the cosmology sampler output; they now match whole numbers only, and the push gate scans the whole committed tree.
entries.why: A partial checkout had let the check fail on GitHub unnoticed.

entries.title: The Chain Decoder and the two chain documents (OTH-072)
entries.what: Every one of the 260 functions the one command loads is explained in the order a traced run enters it, in the Official IAM Operations Manual: Instrument Diagnostics and Chain Decoder; the procedure is now the Official IAM Chain Operator Guide. A push is refused when a function has no entry. Reading the code line by line found items fixed in the chain itself: v3 wording, names, step numbers, a typed reference value and the run's file fingerprint.
entries.why: Researchers will want to take the chain apart and rebuild it, not take it on trust.

entries.title: Every stop explained (OTH-078)
entries.what: Every place the chain stops, withholds or quarantines prints and keeps what it measured, the limit, where the limit comes from, what it means and what to do, and the report shows them; release checks V9 and V11 refuse code that stops without saying why. The push gate names the exact check that refused a push.
entries.why: A researcher who gets a block should know exactly what flagged it without reading the code.

entries.title: Working without our cloud account (OTH-071, OTH-075)
entries.what: With AWS unreadable, the bill was read by hand and recorded, closed day logs carry a declared pending cost block, and Cost Explorer calls are cached. The to-do list gained the steps that wait for the account. The report text is in American spelling, result-card commands wrap, and the page's method text states the middle mark as it is everywhere.
entries.why: The work continues on GitHub while the account is restored.

entries.title: IAM-A's firm rate on the commissioned counter (PHY-049, PHY-006)
entries.what: The firm-rate derivation is to be checked again on the commissioned counter: the five eraser-removed units are recounted with Stage Q2 under their sealed ratio rule, once the account is back.
entries.why: A derivation stands only on the counter that IAM-A now uses.
